content.title: Chapter 54 - MOTOR VEHICLES AND TRAFFIC — Sec. 54-304. - Permit required.
content.summary:
No person or entity shall conduct or carry on the business of offering devices without
               first obtaining a permit from the director under this article.
(Ord. No.
4772
, § 8, 8-16-2021)
